text.description_html:
Laurey 74726, Aventura Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull

The Aventura Cabinet Pull has 5 inch mounting centers and a beautiful Polished Chrome finish. This Aventura Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull has an easy to care for design, making it an ideal handle for high traffic kitchen cabinets. The 5 Inch Polished Chrome Aventura Cabinet Pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection of transitional cabinet hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74726 128mm Pull Aventura Polished Chrome:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5" (128mm)
  • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
